duration.text: The Preparatory course at Shanghai Normal University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per semester ￥ 17000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: (1) Transfer voucher for application fee (RMB 520 or USD 80), payable online (once paid, the fee cannot be refunded); Bank account information (2) Health certificate (issued by a regular hospital; "Foreigner's Physical Examination Form"); (3) High school graduation certificate (fresh graduates can submit an expected graduation certificate; if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached and verified upon arrival in China for registration); (4) Complete high school transcript (if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached); (5) High school entrance examination or college entrance examination transcript from the applicant's home country (if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached); (6) Other certificates that prove personal learning ability or activity ability (if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached); (7) HSK Level 3 or above certificate or a formal institution's certificate of Chinese language study; (8) If there is a university study experience, a complete study transcript must be provided (if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached); (9) Self-introduction (including study plan, etc., 800-1000 words); (10) Resume (must detail the study and work experiences from high school graduation to the present, with continuous and complete time periods); (11) Recommendation letter from a high school teacher or a relevant teacher (the recommendation letter must indicate the position, the institution, the contact number and email address of the recommending teacher, if not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached); (12) Guardianship consent form (only for students under 18 years old); (13) No criminal record certificate (provided by the police station or the school); (14) Valid passport personal information page (15) Electronic 2-inch ID photo

requirements.text: (1) Foreign nationals who are at least 17 years old (scholarship applicants must not be older than 23 years old as of September 1, 2025); (2) In good health (a formal hospital's "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" is required); (3) Excellent academic performance and good potential for learning during high school; (4) For those applying for the preparatory scholarship, the following conditions must also be met: 1) Grade point or average score (grade level): Good or above; 2) Chinese language proficiency: HSK Level 3 or above; 3) Meet the admission requirements of the undergraduate application institutions; 4) Have not received any other types of scholarships from the Chinese government simultaneously.
